description: This file defines the IFieldCodecProvider interface, which provides methods to retrieve codecs for specific types, primarily used in serialization/deserialization processes within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: IFieldCodecProvider
classes.description: Interface for providing access to field codecs, supporting type-specific and type-based retrieval methods.

methods.name: GetCodec
methods.description: Retrieves a codec for a given generic type parameter.

methods.name: TryGetCodec
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a codec for a given generic type parameter, returning null if none found.

methods.name: GetCodec
methods.description: Retrieves a codec for a specified Type object.

methods.name: TryGetCodec
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a codec for a specified Type object, returning null if none found.
